column3: index.html carries an inline boot-failure fallback: a capture-phase error listener on script and modulepreload elements retries once with a ?boot= cache-bust (the param itself is the guard, so it works with storage disabled), then shows a role=alert message with a focused Reload button in system colours; the entry stylesheet counts too; main.tsx sets window.ingleBooted and strips the param without re-encoding the query
column4: A failed startup chunk (vendor, index, runtime) left a blank page with no retry, and BootFailed only covers a /v1/status 503. The fallback needs no JS chunk or stylesheet; the cache-bust reload fetches a fresh index.html, which fixes deploy skew where old hashes are gone
column5: XIN-23 review of #109; e2e/boot.test.ts aborts main.tsx, sees two document loads (the second with boot=), the alert and Reload, then boots after the route is restored
